instructions: Every E2E test added after the baseline must be documented in the current release section, classified as internal with a concrete reason, or explicitly omitted by the release owner with a concrete reason.

reviews.test: keeps a protected recent-items list limited to recipes
evidence: 検索履歴にレシピのないアイテムが残る

reviews.test: loading percentage appears to the right after seven seconds and otherwise leaves the bar full width
evidence: 現在の処理内容と進捗を表示

reviews.test: header information keeps both full lines visible and shrinks each only as needed
reviews.reason: The release owner explicitly designated the current v3.1 tips.md as canonical without a separate header-layout detail.

reviews.test: mobile swipe removes destination panels when the left panel has no navigation target
evidence: 移動するための項目がなくなった後も中央・右パネルへスワイプできる問題

reviews.test: resume skips completed audit and continues from the failed downstream step
reviews.reason: This is a development-only Lodestone pipeline resume safeguard and is not part of the public web app.

reviews.test: share button follows panel availability and opens panel selection on desktop
evidence: 画面右上に共有ボタンを追加

reviews.test: mobile sharing targets only the current panel without showing a selector
evidence: 画面右上に共有ボタンを追加

reviews.test: text sharing copies the complete fallback text with title and footer
evidence: テキストまたはPNG画像で共有

reviews.test: non-PC text sharing keeps the Web Share path
evidence: 対応端末OSの共有機能を利用

reviews.test: favorite, used-in, and material sharing use semantic text blocks and retain material icons
evidence: 共有内容には画面外の項目、個数、製作回数、余り、入手方法、選択中の製作方法なども含まれます

reviews.test: image sharing creates a PNG and falls back to a direct download
evidence: テキストまたはPNG画像で共有

reviews.test: image sharing keeps the selected recipe method and its job icon
evidence: 選択中の製作方法なども含まれます

reviews.test: panel selection highlights the full left and middle panels above the modal backdrop
evidence: 画面右上に共有ボタンを追加

reviews.test: image generation is exclusive across tabs and releases after discard
five retained downloads disable only new image creation until expiry
file share failure regenerates at a smaller scale before the next user action
evidence: 対応端末OSの共有機能を利用

reviews.test: share assets are precached and the app reloads offline under Service Worker control
evidence: 画面右上に共有ボタンを追加

reviews.test: share controls and dialog fit compact devices at the largest font size
evidence: 画面右上に共有ボタンを追加
